sloka: राक्षसानामनीकेषु शैलवर्षं ववर्ष ह।अश्मवर्षं यथा मेघः पक्षिसङ्घेषु कानने ।। ६.९७.११ ।।
transliteration: rākṣasānāmanīkeṣu śailavarṣaṁ vavarṣa ha।aśmavarṣaṁ yathā meghaḥ pakṣisaṅgheṣu kānane ।। 6.97.11 ।।

translations.english: Just as clouds shower hail stones on flocks of birds in the forest, Sugriva rained showers of rocks on the Rakshasas.
